headline: AMD bets $5B on Anthropic as compute race accelerates
body: A day of huge compute deals. AMD committed up to $5 billion to Anthropic, which will deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, and OpenAI unveiled 'Project Camellia', a 3.2-gigawatt data-center campus in Georgia. Both raised Capability Velocity, which lifts the endings that need very capable AI: Enslaved God, Descendants and Zookeeper. The AMD deal also concentrates power with a leading lab, adding to Enslaved God and Zookeeper. Faster progress pushes Reversion down. Elsewhere, the White House accused Moonshot of distilling Anthropic's model and evading chip curbs, a small blow to Global Coordination. Mistral signed an Azure deal to grow European compute, and Monday.com cut about 20% of staff in an AI-linked restructuring. Horizon Balance slipped to -1.68.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.6 came from the AMD-Anthropic deal (+0.38) and Project Camellia (+0.23); Reversion -0.5 and Descendants +0.5 split evenly between the same two stories (-0.23/+0.23 each).
coming_up: OpenAI's Project Camellia campus in Georgia to have power phased in from 2028 to 2032
